advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 20/24 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Launch wheelspin on the rears: accel diff lock down / taller 1st, or squeeze the throttle.
advice.evidence: median peak rear slip 7.85; 3/3 launches spun

advice.text: AWD fronts spinning at launch: center split more rearward / front accel diff down.
Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.343 over 24 corners (13 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.87) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 12 stops (0 both-axle, 2 front-first, 1 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
